commits.message:
Add SweetAlert toast support and PairUI toast API

Introduce a unified toast system with dual-driver support (iziToast and SweetAlert2). Adds a new Pair\Html\SweetToast class, expands PairUI (assets/PairUI.js) with normalization helpers, driver-aware rendering, and a PairUI.toast API (configure, show, info, success, warning, error, question, getConfig/getDriver). Update PHP Application to track a toastDriver, expose PairToastConfig to the client, accept multiple reserved cookie toast classes, and create/get/set toast driver methods; also adjust toast-related type hints and add a runtime check for toast notification objects. Update AppTrait to proxy getToastDriver/setToastDriver and reflect the new return types. Bump PairUI version to 0.4.1.

Add PHPUnit tests and v3 docs updates

Enable a PHPUnit-based test suite and update repository docs for Pair v3. Adds phpunit.xml.dist, a tests/ tree with support/helpers and unit tests, and composer.lock. Updates composer.json to include phpunit as a require-dev, a "test" script, and autoload-dev for tests. Documentation files (AGENTS.md, CODEX.md, GEMINI.md, PAIR_ARCHITECTURE.md, PAIR_PATTERNS.md, PAIR_TASKS.md, SKILL.md) were revised to target Pair v3 and to reorganize/simplify guidance and ownership. .gitattributes and .gitignore updated to export-ignore test/config files and ignore /vendor and PHPUnit cache.

Revoke unusable subscriptions instead of deleting

Stop hard-deleting subscriptions on delivery failures and mark them for revocation so they remain traceable. Update PushDispatcher to call repository->revokeByEndpoint, adjust DeliveryResult docs to clarify the legacy property name, and add WebPushSender::shouldRevokeSubscription to centralize logic (404/410 and Apple VapidPkHashMismatch on 400) for detecting non-reusable subscriptions.

Add WhatsApp Cloud client and webhook support

Introduce WhatsApp Cloud API integration: add Pair\Services\WhatsAppCloudClient with outbound messaging, media upload/download, webhook helpers (signature verification, challenge validation, payload decoding and event extraction), and HTTP request handling. Wire webhook handling into API controller (GET/POST /api/whatsappWebhook), add lazy client instantiation and a handleWhatsAppWebhook hook. Add required env defaults and example vars (WHATSAPP_CLOUD_*), add WHATSAPP_ERROR code, and adjust routing in Application to allow whatsappWebhook action. Outbound calls require WHATSAPP_CLOUD_ACCESS_TOKEN and WHATSAPP_CLOUD_PHONE_NUMBER_ID; webhook verification requires WHATSAPP_CLOUD_WEBHOOK_VERIFY_TOKEN and WHATSAPP_CLOUD_APP_SECRET.

Replace TelegramSender with TelegramBotClient

Introduce a new TelegramBotClient service (full-featured Telegram Bot API client) and remove the old TelegramSender class. Update Logger to import and use TelegramBotClient (use sendMessage and allow negative chat IDs; treat 0 as invalid). Add TELEGRAM_* env variables to .env.example for API base URL, timeouts and webhook secret. Update scripts/upgrade-to-v3.php to remap legacy TelegramNotifier/TelegramSender references to TelegramBotClient and to warn about remaining legacy usages.

Add Google Maps integration and form control

Introduce Google Maps support: add frontend asset PairGoogleMaps.js to wire Places Autocomplete and new GoogleAddress form control with optional hidden metadata fields. Add GoogleMaps helper to load the Maps JS API, server-side GoogleMapsClient, GoogleGeocoder and GooglePlacesService for API interactions, and register a Form::googleAddress convenience method. Add env vars and defaults for API keys and timeouts (.env.example and Env.php) and a new GOOGLE_MAPS_ERROR error code.

Ensure list pagination restarts when sorting changes and normalize custom-route params.

Introduce extensive form-level state and rendering API: new properties (action, autocomplete, attributes, enctype, formClasses, id, method, novalidate, target) and chainable setters (action(), autocomplete(), attribute(), attributes(), classForForm(), enctype(), id(), method(), novalidate(), target()). Add fill() to populate controls from arrays/objects/ActiveRecord. Replace values() logic to delegate to fill().

Add rendering helpers: open(), close(), render(), renderControls(), printOpen(), printClose(), print() and automatic enctype resolution (resolvedEnctype()) that enables multipart/form-data when file controls exist. Validation helpers: collectInvalidControls() (used by isValid() and unvalidControls()). Add hasFileControls() helper. Enforce validation for enctype, method and target inputs.

Small API change in FormControl: printLabel() was converted to renderLabel() returning the label string (printLabel() kept as a printing wrapper) and label 'for' prefers the control id when present. Overall refactor centralizes form rendering and improves attribute/configuration handling.

Call Exception constructor; detect missing columns

PairException now calls parent::__construct(...) to ensure standard Exception initialization and preserve previous-exception behavior.

Normalize query booleans and update docs

Add a private normalizeQueryBooleans method to AircallClient and call it before building the query string so boolean values are converted to 'true'/'false' strings (recursive).

Normalize and handle raw error codes in Logger

Add normalizeErrorCode() to coerce raw error codes (ints or numeric strings) into int|null, trimming and rejecting non-numeric values.

Handle Throwable in front-end; add Database::value

Pass actual Throwable to PairException::frontEnd from Application so exceptions can be logged and rendered with full debug info in non-production. PairException now accepts string|Throwable, logs exceptions, and builds a detailed debug message (including chained causes) while still showing a generic localized message in production. Add Database::value helper to return the first column of the first row (normalizing PDO false to null) for convenient scalar queries. Also add CODEX.md to .gitattributes export-ignore.
Make AGENTS.md the primary entrypoint

Add API rate limiting with Redis fallback

Introduce API rate limiting: add env defaults and .env.example entries and suggest ext-redis in composer. ApiController now registers ThrottleMiddleware by default. Implement a new RateLimiter with Redis primary storage and a file-based fallback, plus a RateLimitResult value object for standardized headers and metadata. ThrottleMiddleware resolves stable keys (session, bearer token, user, or IP) and returns 429 with retry information when exceeded. Request now honors trusted proxy configuration and correctly parses Forwarded / X-Forwarded-For headers to determine the client IP.

PairUI v0.4.0: add http, persist, feedback

Bump PairUI to 0.4.0 and PairSW to pair-sw-v4. Adds a large set of client utilities: html/raw templating, safe HTML interpolation withLoading/run for async loading states, enhanced http helpers (buildQuery/buildUrl/formData/parseResponse/request + convenience methods), and a PairUI.persist API for Pair-style cookie-backed persistent state (serialize/deserialize/get/set/unset/bind). Also includes small performance and correctness improvements to reactive state (avoid notifications when values unchanged), improved attribute-list parsing, DOM helpers, and appended usage examples and docs.

Handle Aircall 429 with specific exception

Add a new Pair\Exceptions\AircallRateLimitException and update AircallClient to throw it when Aircall returns HTTP 429. Change retry logic so 429 responses are not automatically retried (caller must handle rate-limit behavior). Also add the necessary use import and replace generic PairException throws for 429 in the various error paths (valid JSON, invalid JSON, and general non-2xx responses). Remove premature curl_close($ch) calls in AircallClient so the cURL handle remains usable across retry attempts.

Validate S3 object keys and use PairException

Add validation helpers and stricter error handling for S3 operations. Introduce hasObjectKey() and requireObjectKey() to prevent calling the AWS SDK with empty keys, and add early-return guards in delete, deleteDir, exists, presignedUrl, get and read. Replace thrown generic \Exception instances with PairException (preserving error codes and original exceptions where appropriate). Also ensure put/read call requireObjectKey and improve some error messages and flow control to avoid invalid operations.

Use isSecureRequest() for HTTPS detection

Introduce a private static isSecureRequest() helper that determines whether the current request is effectively HTTPS by checking common server vars and proxy headers (HTTPS, SERVER_PORT, X-Forwarded-Proto, X-Forwarded-SSL, REQUEST_SCHEME, CF-Visitor) and returns false on CLI.

Bug fix and clarify docs hierarchy and agent guidance

Include float in Database::load return type. Avoid treating missing CSRF tokens as errors. If the exception code is `ErrorCodes::CSRF_TOKEN_NOT_FOUND`.
Update src/Orm/Database.php to add float to the union return type of Database::load. Promote SKILL.md as the primary entrypoint and consolidate guidance across documentation.

Add agent docs and update framework guidelines

Add comprehensive guidance for AI agents and update core docs. New files: .github/copilot-instructions.md, CODEX.md, PAIR_ARCHITECTURE.md, PAIR_CONTEXT.md, PAIR_PATTERNS.md, and PAIR_TASKS.md — all provide navigation, conventions, architecture, patterns, task runbooks, and agent-specific rules. Modify AGENTS.md (repository exploration, workflow, checklists, PR expectations), CLAUDE.md (explicit reading order and guidance), GEMINI.md (expanded conventions, security, routing, coding standards, testing, performance and project overview), and SKILL.md (expanded entrypoint, capabilities, canonical references, runbook and version bump to 3.3). These changes consolidate single-source guidance for contributors and automated agents, clarify priorities and workflows, and emphasize minimal, backward-compatible, secure changes.

Add pair.css; improve asset copy & localization

Add new assets/pair.css with UI styles (logbar, toggles, list filters, print rules).

Update scripts/copy-assets.php to accept an optional asset type argument (js|css), treat relative target paths as project-root relative, create destination directories on demand, optionally filter copied files by extension, and print a concise summary message. Improve iterator handling to skip directories and preserve source folder structure.

Enhance src/Exceptions/PairException.php by adding localizeOutputMessage() to translate or sanitize user-facing error messages (fallback to a generic message for non-English locales) and use it when not in production to avoid exposing raw/internal messages.

Improve Translator locale handling and parsing

Make Translator more robust: initialize internal caches, add requireDefaultLocale() to ensure a default Locale or throw a PairException with a specific ErrorCodes code, and use it where Locale::getDefault() was previously called. Add safer browser-language checks, reuse cached default strings when appropriate, and ensure defaultStrings is validated before lookup. Harden parsing and formatting: handle parse_ini_file failures with a warning, wrap vsprintf in a try/catch to log malformed placeholders, and adjust file load order so common translations are preferred while pair files act as fallbacks. Also update imports, small doc/type fixes, and ensure getDefaultFileName() uses the singleton instance.

Streamed report export, DB iterator, color alpha

Add streaming support and several enhancements across utilities, DB and report services.

- Add Database::iterateDictionary() generator to stream associative query rows with detailed PDO error handling and query logging, avoiding full-result buffering.
- Refactor Report to write rows to an SplTempFileObject (base64+serialize) to reduce memory usage, provide getRows() generator, and lazily populate columns/rows from SQL via Database::iterateDictionary().
- Add CSV features: configurable delimiter/enclosure/escape/EOL, download format selection (CSV/XLSX), CSV saving path, and CSV-to-XLSX conversion using existing utility.
- Introduce row counting and query parameter support for reports, plus helper methods for CSV options and download format.
- Improve Utilities::isDarkColor(): validate/parse 3/4/6/8-digit hex, support optional base color for alpha compositing, fix sRGB conversion threshold and return correct dark/light decision.

These changes reduce memory pressure for large reports, support alpha-blended colors, and provide flexible CSV/XLSX export options.

Migrate template palettes to JSON and add palette API

Add a migration to convert templates.palette from CSV/VARCHAR to JSON and drop deprecated templates.derived. Refactor Template model to treat palette as JSON: add DEFAULT_PALETTE, sanitize/normalize helpers, palette getters (getPaletteColor/getPaletteColors), deterministic color mapping (colorByIdentifier/stringHashToIndex), color utilities (hex<->rgb, hsl->rgb, validators), and a closest-color matcher. Maintain backward compatibility when loading plugin options and populate/store flows (CSV <-> JSON conversion hooks). Update ChartJs helper to source colors from the active template (color/colors), auto-assign dataset backgroundColor for multi-color chart types and handle color offsets across datasets. Extend Utilities::isDarkColor to support 3/4/6/8-digit hex formats (ignoring alpha). Update Application to stop loading legacy derived.php and update User::avatar to accept a class prefix and derive avatar background from template palette. Create migration file migrations/20260228_templates_palette.sql to perform the data convert and alter table.

Add migration source column and model support

Add a DB migration that adds a new ENUM `source` column to `migrations` and sets existing rows to 'app'. Update the Migration ActiveRecord: import Database, add a nullable $source property, define SOURCE_APP/SOURCE_PAIR constants, and add afterPrepareData() to detect absence of the column (via describeColumn) and remove the field from the loaded DB object for backward compatibility. Also update GEMINI.md with guidelines to prefer short public/private method names.

Bug fix

Bug fix in Audit.php. Add .env.example, gitattributes; update docs. Add a .env.example with configuration defaults and secrets placeholders, and add a .gitattributes to exclude repo-only files from composer dist archives. Revamp README and update _config.yml with site metadata (url, baseurl, repository and documentation links) for GitHub Pages.

Add optional version param for Chart.js CDN

Allow callers to specify a Chart.js (and datalabels) version when loading from the CDN. Updated ChartJs::load(string $version = '') and ChartJs::loadDatalabels(string $version = '') to build the CDN URL and append '@<version>' if a non-empty version is provided (trimmed). Defaults preserve previous behavior. Example versions: '4.4.1' for Chart.js and '2.2.0' for chartjs-plugin-datalabels. Keeps existing Chart.register(ChartDataLabels) call for the plugin.

Passkey: load DB rows, parse transports, add redirectUrl

Replace UserPasskey model call with a direct Database::load query to fetch active passkeys, parse JSON-encoded transports, and normalize returned fields (id, credentialId, createdAt, lastUsedAt). Add Database import. In passkeyLoginVerify, compute a redirectUrl from lastRequestedUrl or the user's landing (fallback to user/profile) and include it in the authentication response. Also apply minor defensive/formatting tweaks to credential/response checks for consistency.

Harden remember-me, add ChartJs resize debounce

Security and UX improvements across auth and charts:

- Application: set HttpOnly on cookie params to mitigate XSS token access.
- ChartJs: add DEFAULT_RESIZE_DELAY_MS, enable responsive by default, set resizeDelay default, and add resizeDelay(int) method to configure debounce before redraw.
- User model: migrate remember-me handling to a safer scheme — generate secure random tokens, store a deterministic SHA-256-based hash in DB, and emit a v2 cookie payload (base64url JSON) that carries the plain token and timezone. Added helpers to build/parse v2 payloads and compute token hashes.
  - Keep backwards compatibility with legacy plain-text tokens when validating and rotating tokens.
  - Rotate tokens on renew, ensure only the newest token remains in DB, and clean up stale or malformed cookies on failures.
  - Consolidate error handling around token generation and payload construction.
- UserRemember query updated to search by hashed token or legacy token and prefer newest match.

These changes harden remember-me storage, reduce token exposure in DB, improve cookie handling, and add a small UX enhancement for Chart.js resizing behavior.

Wrap Telegram sender in try-catch

Wrap TelegramSender creation and message send loop in a try-catch that catches \Throwable to ensure Telegram notification failures don't break application flow. Minor formatting/spacing adjusted. The existing checks for telegram thresholds and chat IDs are unchanged.

Add Passkey/WebAuthn authentication support

Introduce full Passkey/WebAuthn support: add a browser helper (assets/PairPasskey.js), a PasskeyAuth service for challenge lifecycle, verification and registration (src/Services/PasskeyAuth.php), a persistent model for credentials (src/Models/UserPasskey.php) and API endpoints (src/Api/PasskeyController.php). Integrate with existing app flow by starting a session for passkey login when no sid is present and adding an option to include PairPasskey.js in loadPwaScripts (src/Core/Application.php). Also add User::doLoginById to create a session for users authenticated via external factors. Exposed endpoints (login/register/options/verify, list, revoke) and client usage are documented in README.md.

Add AircallClient service and error code

Introduce src/Services/AircallClient.php — a full Aircall API wrapper with helpers for calls, contacts, numbers, teams, tags, webhooks, messages and more. Implements HTTP basic auth, request/response handling, retry/backoff logic, pagination, URL normalization and input validation.

Add PWA helpers, SW & device/router assets

Introduce standalone PWA frontend assets (no build step): PairPWA, PairSW (service worker), PairRouter, PairSkeleton and PairDevice for easy script-tag usage. Add backend helpers for PWA support and idempotency: src/Helpers/PwaConfig.php, src/Helpers/PwaManifest.php and src/Api/Idempotency.php. Update core files (Request.php, Application.php, AppTrait.php) to integrate PWA manifest/script support and idempotency handling. Update README with usage examples covering SW registration, background-sync queueing, offline fallback and idempotent replay handling.

Normalize session_time and expire API sessions

Ensure session lifetime is normalized (cast to int and min 1) and apply cleanup for headless/API requests. Reject and remove expired API sessions (audit + delete) before extending timeouts and return a 401. Also apply the same session_time normalization when initializing regular sessions. Additionally, update the v3 upgrade script to rename setGuestModule() to guestModule(). Small improvements to Markdown and FormControl classes.

Default to 'label' class for toggle labels

Always render a class attribute for the toggle label by defaulting $labelClass to 'label' when $this->labelClass is not set.

Update ActiveRecord and QueryGrammar

Enhance wrapTable to handle table aliases and raw tables. Bug fix in html() method.

Add SKILL.md and link it from docs

Introduce SKILL.md as the lightweight entrypoint for assistants (metadata, scope, precedence, and a minimal runbook). Update AGENTS.md and CLAUDE.md to reference SKILL.md as the starting point and adjust checklist formatting. Add a Language/i18n section to GEMINI.md (default English, translations folder guidance). These changes clarify the canonical entry and conflict-resolution order for contributors and bots.

Safer cookie unserialize and Geo method for ChartJs helper

Harden cookie deserialization by catching unserialize failures and discarding tampered or invalid cookie values instead of throwing exceptions.
Update ChartJs.php

Remove legacy Token model and auth paths

Delete the Token active record and remove legacy token-based auth code paths in controllers and application bootstrap. src/Models/Token.php was removed; ApiController no longer references a Token property or setToken(), and Application no longer reads or validates a `token` GET parameter or calls Token::getByValue()/updateLastUse(). The flow is simplified to only use OAuth2 bearer tokens (OAuth2Token) and SID from GET.

Refactor ActiveRecord & Query and enhance Markdown helper

Reorganize ActiveRecord internals and add richer, safer query helpers.
Improvements to src/Helpers/Markdown.php: added HTML escaping, adjusted processing order (strong before em, images before links), sanitizeUrl handling and support for internal fragment links (uses Router::getInstance()->getUrl()), added/relocated slugify, and expanded Markdown parsing for fenced code blocks, headings, lists, horizontal rules and blockquotes.

Refactor OAuth2 client/token, Mailer::getBody and PairUI

Refactor Mailer::getBody to modernize and simplify the HTML email template. Rename and refactor OAuth2 client/token APIs, improve validation and lifetime handling. Add formRoot and ctx helpers to PairUI

Suppress unserialize warnings and version check

Use version_compare() to correctly detect PHP >= 8.4 and add error suppression to unserialize calls. This avoids PHP warnings being emitted when unserializing cookie or input data while preserving existing throw_on_error and try/catch handling.

Integrate ActiveRecord hydration into Query

Add ActiveRecord <-> Query integration and extend query builder features. ActiveRecord gains hydrateFromRow and a set of static query helpers (query, where, whereNull/NotNull, whereIn/NotIn, whereBetween, orderBy, latest, oldest) to start fluent queries. Query now supports a modelClass for hydrating results into ActiveRecord instances (setModel, getModelClass, hasModel, sharedLock) and returns model objects from get(), first(), and firstOrFail() when a model is set; logging is added when loading model objects. Query also receives utility methods and improvements: addSelect, joinRaw, joinSub, joinWhere, leftJoinSub, joinWhere variants, pagination (paginate), pluck, offset/limit, __toString and other rework of join/lock behaviors. QueryGrammar is refactored: compileColumns, compileLimit, compileOffset and compileSelect have been reorganized and identifier wrapping (wrapAliasedIdentifier / wrapIdentifier) improved to better handle aliased and raw expressions. These changes enable ORM-level hydration and richer SQL construction. Update Textarea.php. Update GEMINI.md.

Add API package and middleware; query fixes

Introduce a new Pair\Api package (ApiController, ApiResponse, Request, Resource, Middleware, MiddlewarePipeline, CorsMiddleware, ThrottleMiddleware, RateLimiter) and register it in composer autoload. Application now runs the ApiController middleware pipeline before invoking actions. Improve ORM behavior: ActiveRecord::exists() delegates to Query::exists(), Query::exists() uses a selectRaw(1) + limit(1) short-circuit, and QueryGrammar::wrapAliasedIdentifier() avoids wrapping '*' or raw/numeric expressions. These changes add JSON API helpers, CORS/throttle middleware, file-based rate limiting, and tighten SQL generation for existence checks.

Refactor Query builder; extract QueryGrammar

Introduce QueryGrammar to handle SQL compilation and identifier wrapping, moving compile logic out of Query (new src/Orm/QueryGrammar.php). Convert JoinClause to hold type/table and expose clauses/bindings with a constructor and getBindings. Switch Query to store joins as JoinClause objects, make many internal properties public so the grammar can read them, and centralize binding aggregation in getBindings(). Add/adjust many query builder helpers (aggregate, count, avg, sum, min, max, select/selectRaw/selectSub, addSelect, groupBy, crossJoin, leftJoin/leftJoinWhere/rightJoinSub, latest/oldest, forPage, whereBetween/whereNull/whereNotExists and multiple orWhere variants). Remove/replace the old compileSelect/compile* methods in Query and delegate SQL generation to QueryGrammar, and move identifier wrapping into the grammar for consistent behavior. Overall this is a large refactor to separate concerns and enable more flexible join/SQL handling.

Add OneSignal notification service and enhance ElkLogger

Introduces OneSignalNotification class for sending push notifications to users or segments via OneSignal API, including support for cancellation and localization. Enhances ElkLogger by adding an optional context parameter to the log method and sets cURL timeouts for improved reliability.

Refactor push notification classes and improve docs

Reordered and documented methods in SubscriptionRepository, moving deleteByEndpoint above upsert for clarity. Added and improved docblocks and inline comments in DeliveryResult, PushDispatcher, and WebPushSender for better maintainability. No functional changes were made except for code organization and documentation enhancements.

Add routing documentation for Pair apps

Expanded GEMINI.md and README.md with details on routing and URL mapping in Pair applications, including module, controller, action resolution, and auto-loading conventions.

Add lightweight Markdown to HTML converter

Introduces a Markdown helper class that converts a subset of Markdown syntax to HTML, supporting headings, lists, code blocks, inline formatting, links, images, and blockquotes. The implementation is optimized for speed and simple use cases.

Add Toggle form control and update button/time controls

Introduced a new Toggle form control for toggle switch inputs. Updated Form to support the new Toggle control and removed the Font Awesome icon parameter from buildButton. Improved type handling in the Time control for min, max, and value methods.

Refactor ORM to use Query builder for SQL generation

Replaces raw SQL string construction in ActiveRecord and Model with a new Query builder class, improving parameter binding and query composition. Adds a JoinClause builder for join conditions. Updates methods in ActiveRecord and Model to use Query for select, count, exists, and related operations, enhancing maintainability and security. Updates coding standards documentation to recommend alphabetical ordering of methods.

Enhance authentication and added hooks

Refactored User model to add before/after hooks for remember-me token lifecycle, improved password hashing and verification with secure random string generation, and standardized authentication failure messages. Updated translations to include a generic authentication failure message. Also clarified hook method comments in ActiveRecord for consistency. Bug fix to  upgrade-to-v3.php script and WebPushSender.php class. Added
AGENTS.md and GEMINI.md new files.

Improve .env value parsing and add class docblocks

Enhanced Env class to correctly handle quoted .env values, preserving them as strings and only casting unquoted values. Added docblocks to Env and PushSubscription classes for better code documentation.

Add optional date format pattern to rangeLabels

The rangeLabels method now accepts an optional pattern parameter to customize the date format for labels. The interval validation has been moved into the switch statement, and default patterns are set only if not provided.

Improve guest module action checks and super user access

Enhanced guest module action detection in Application.php to handle modules with empty action lists and default actions. Updated User.php to use __get for 'super' property access, ensuring compatibility with property overloading. Updated placeholder attribute check in FormControl by removing the empty string check for the placeholder attribute, allowing placeholders with empty string values to be rendered in the output.

Add empty CSV file check in Utilities

Added a check to throw an exception if the provided CSV file is empty or has an invalid mime type before proceeding with further processing.

Refactor LogBar for modularity and memory safety

Refactored the LogBar helper class to modularize HTML rendering into dedicated methods, improve memory usage checks, and centralize cookie handling for log visibility. Added constants for configuration, improved method documentation, and enhanced memory limit and usage ratio calculations to prevent out-of-memory errors. The changes increase maintainability, readability, and robustness of the logging utility.

Refactor Template to TemplateRenderer and admin to super user

Moved the template parsing logic from Template.php to a new TemplateRenderer.php class in the Html namespace. Updated Application.php to use TemplateRenderer for parsing templates. Also reordered imports in SubscriptionRepository.php for consistency. Replaces 'admin' terminology with 'super' user across models, permissions, and helpers for clarity and consistency. Refactors template variable assignment and rendering in Application and TemplateRenderer, allowing dynamic variables to be set and used in templates. Updates session handling to allow for null sessions and improves impersonation logic and audit tracking. Minor bug fixes and doc improvements included.

Add Web Push notification support

Introduces Web Push notification functionality, including client-side subscription management (PairPush.js), PHP models and repositories for push subscriptions, VAPID configuration, and integration with the Minishlink WebPush library. Adds scripts for asset copying and removes the old copy-pair-ui script.

Add PairUI.js client helpers for Pair Framework

Introduces PairUI.js, a lightweight client-side utility for server-rendered apps using the Pair Framework. Provides progressive enhancement via data-* directives, a reactive store, DOM bindings, safe event argument parsing, and fetch helpers, all without a build step.

Refactor audit methods to void return type and update env defaults

Changed audit tracking methods in Audit.php to use void return type instead of bool, and updated their logic to use 'and' instead of 'or' for environment variable checks. Removed audit-related default environment variables from Env.php. Improved and clarified docblocks for audit methods.

Improve error handling in MVC flow and view rendering

Replaced generic Exception catches with Throwable to handle all errors, ensuring more robust error handling in both Application and View classes. Updated error reporting to use modals instead of toast notifications for resource not found, and improved exception messages for controller instantiation failures. The View::display method now shows a modal on render errors and redirects if not using the default layout.

Add DateRange helper class for date interval operations

Introduces a new DateRange class providing utilities for half-open date ranges, including creation, expansion, intersection, shifting, and SQL query support. This class simplifies date range manipulation and querying throughout the application.

Add colorFunction method for dynamic background colors

Introduces the colorFunction method to ChartJsDataset, allowing users to specify a callback for computing background colors per data point. This enhances flexibility by supporting dynamic color assignment based on data context.

Add user avatar HTML method and improve color contrast

Introduced a User::avatar() method to generate an avatar with user initials and a consistent background color based on user ID, using improved color contrast logic. Updated Utilities::isDarkColor() to use WCAG luminance and contrast ratio for better accessibility and support for 3- and 6-digit hex codes.

Refactor resource management and docblocks in services and ORM

Removed redundant curl_close calls in AmazonS3, ElkLogger, and TelegramSender to improve resource management. Updated docblocks and exception messages in ActiveRecord for clarity. Fixed PDO attribute usage in Database to use correct constants.

AmazonS3 class improvements

AmazonS3 class improvements. Better consistency with PHP standards. Updates docblocks and method signatures to reflect these changes, improving code readability and maintainability.

Refactor Schedule helper for clarity and consistency

Renamed parameters and properties for clarity (e.g., 'params' to 'args'), standardized boolean values to lowercase, and improved time formatting in scheduling methods. Removed unused imports and enhanced code readability and maintainability throughout the Schedule class.

Refactor session and timezone handling in Application and User

Improves session management by storing the Session object in Application, refactors timezone handling to use session data, and updates related methods in User and Session models. Cleans up magic getters, documentation, and boolean return values for consistency. Also updates Utilities helper for PHP type conventions and improves code comments and parameter naming throughout.

Improves type hints and docblocks, bug fix

Replaces usage of TRUE/FALSE and NULL with true/false and null across all files for consistency with PHP standards. Also updates default parameter values to use lowercase booleans and null, and improves type hints and docblocks to match these changes. Small bug fixes.

Refactor Schedule methods to return function result.

Changed all scheduling methods in Schedule.php to return the result of the scheduled function instead of a boolean. Updated type hints and docblocks to reflect the new return type, and added new methods for twenty-minute and daily-at-noon scheduling. This improves flexibility for consumers of the Schedule class. Allow custom message in noData method. Update README.md. Refactor OAuth2 models and improve documentation.

Refactor raw request handling to headless mode

Replaces the 'raw' request logic with a 'headless' mode in Application, Controller, Router, and Exception handling. This change centralizes output suppression and simplifies API/AJAX response management by using a headless flag instead of scattered raw checks. Removes related Router methods and properties, updates Controller view logic, and adds AppTrait support for headless mode.
Refactor saveS3 to throw exception on upload error.

Refactor session and guest module handling

Reworked Application session initialization to support per-action guest module access and improved unauthenticated handling. Added guestModule method for fine-grained guest access, removed setGuestModules, and centralized RememberMe login auditing. Minor whitespace fix in Audit and ensured RememberMe login is always audited in User.

Add CSRF token check and improve POST helpers

Introduces Form::checkToken() for boolean CSRF validation and adds Post::string() for retrieving POST parameters as strings. Also refactors Post::trim() to use the new string method for consistency.

Refactor logger, controller, and view handling

Refactored Logger to improve PSR-3 compliance, unify log level handling, and clarify transport configuration. Controller now stores a View object instead of a string, with view loading logic moved to a dedicated method. Alpha filter rendering was moved from View to Utilities. SendMail class was renamed to Sendmail for consistency.

Update Logger.php

Bug fix

Add StripeGateway service and Stripe error code

Introduces StripeGateway, a service class for handling Stripe payments, webhooks, checkout sessions, payment intents, and refunds with centralized error handling and configuration.

Refactor logging to use PSR-3 and context interpolation

Reworked the Logger class to implement PSR-3 LoggerInterface, added context interpolation for log messages, and replaced static Logger calls with instance-based usage throughout the codebase. Introduced a Log helper facade for PSR-3 log levels. Updated exception handling, validation, and plugin management to use contextual logging. Improved error tracking integration and added documentation for service classes. Composer dependencies updated to require PSR/log and PHP 8.5 support.

Refactor AmazonS3 service and add presigned URL support

Reorganized AmazonS3 class properties for clarity and added methods for deleting files and directories, checking file existence, and generating presigned URLs with expiration. Improved error handling and added a method to verify URL validity. The changes enhance S3 integration and provide more robust file management and access control.

Add Meter and Progress form controls, refactor value handling

Introduces Meter and Progress form controls with appropriate properties and rendering methods. Refactors value handling for date-related controls (Date, Datetime, Month, Time) to support DateTime objects and user timezones. Updates FormControl to add aria, caption, inputmode, and title methods, and changes Button and Textarea to use caption for display. Adds new error codes for invalid form control methods and properties.

Refactor session user ID, add impersonation audit and bug fix

Added impersonation and impersonation stop tracking to Audit, with corresponding methods in User. Many renaming. Introduces a new copy() method to the Collection class, allowing for shallow or deep copying of collection items. Deep copy recursively duplicates arrays and clones objects, preserving references for non-cloneable items such as closures and resources.
Small bug fixes.

Fix minute formatting in DATETIME_FORMAT translations

Corrected the minute format specifier in DATETIME_FORMAT for both English and Italian translations to use 'mm' instead of 'm', ensuring proper display of minutes.

Fix badge rendering for null values in menus

Updated badge display logic in BootstrapMenu and Menu classes to check for non-null badge values instead of truthy checks. This ensures badges with falsy values (e.g., 0) are rendered correctly.

Refactor CSRF token handling and improve error reporting

Refactored Form class to separate CSRF token generation and printing, ensuring token is only generated if not present in session. Improved error handling in ActiveRecord by throwing an exception when filtering by a non-existent property in findByAttributes().

Refactor menu active item handling and widget parsing

Removed activeMenuItem from Application and refactored menu active item logic to use Router in Menu. Added availableWidgets() to Widget and updated Template to parse and render widget placeholders in style files. Also replaced setFontAwesomeSize and setFontAwesomeStyle with fontAwesomeSize and fontAwesomeStyle methods in Menu.

Introduces a new MenuEntry class for menu items, replacing stdClass usage and improving type safety. Refactors Menu and BootstrapMenu to support dropdowns, icons, badges, and accessibility attributes. Updates rendering logic and menu item creation for consistency and extensibility.

Refactoring and improvements to ChartJs and TelegramSender

Introduces a new link() method that returns a t.me link for a chat based on its numeric chat ID, using the associated username. Returns an empty string if the username is not found.

Refactored the render() method to use a new renderConfig() method for generating the Chart.js configuration object. This improves code organization and reusability by separating configuration generation from rendering logic.

Renamed TelegramNotifier to TelegramSender and updated all references accordingly. Refactored and renamed methods for clarity (e.g., sendMessage to message, sendImage to photo, getChatIdByUsername to chatIdByUsername). Expanded the ChartJs color palette with new, more descriptive color options.

The message() method now accepts an optional $parseMode parameter, allowing messages to specify formatting modes such as HTML or Markdown. This enables richer message formatting when sending messages via Telegram.

Add image sending support to TelegramNotifier

Refactored the message sending logic into a common private send() method to handle different Telegram API methods. Added a new sendImage() method to support sending images by URL or local file, with optional captions. Improved error handling and response parsing for Telegram API errors.
